llm_notes:
1. **Create a query-matched comparison page with a precise title and H1.**  
   - Title: **AeroGarden Harvest vs Harvest Elite: Features, Price & Which One to Buy**  
   - H1: **AeroGarden Harvest vs. Harvest Elite**  
   - Add a 40–60-word verdict directly below the H1: choose Harvest for the lowest-cost entry; choose Elite for the stainless-steel finish, LCD controls, and vacation mode. The Elite grows six plants under a 20W light with up to 12 inches of grow height.[1][3][9]  
   - Add a visible “Jump to comparison” link below the introduction.

2. **Ship a scannable comparison table instead of another prose-heavy review.**  
   Include these rows:

   | Feature | AeroGarden Harvest | Harvest Elite |
   |---|---|---|
   | Plant capacity | 6 pods | 6 pods |
   | Grow height | 12 inches | 12 inches |
   | Light | 20W LED | 20W LED |
   | Finish | Matte plastic | Stainless steel |
   | LCD controls | No | Yes |
   | Vacation mode | No | Yes |
   | Best for | Lowest upfront cost | Better controls and appearance |

   Put the table above the first long section, repeat the preferred CTA beneath it, and add a “last checked” date plus affiliate disclosure. The core product differences—finish and vacation mode—are supported by AeroGarden’s product information.[1][9]

3. **Build one dedicated “under $50” roundup targeting all three lower-funnel queries.**  
   - Title: **5 Best Indoor Herb Gardens Under $50 in 2026**  
   - H1: **Best Cheap, Compact Indoor Herb Gardens Under $50**  
   - Use a short “best for” format: **Best overall**, **Best compact**, **Best for healthy growth**
